ListSparkJob.title: Fetch historical job information of a Data Lake Analytics Spark virtual cluster
ListSparkJob.summary: Fetch paginated historical job details of a specific Data Lake Analytics Spark virtual cluster.
ListSparkJob.requestParamsDescription:
Condition is a string in JSON format. The following parameters are currently supported:
- status: The status of the Spark job. Valid values are as follows:
    - starting: Submitting.
    - running: Running.
    - success: Succeeded.
    - error: Failed.
    - killed: Canceled.
    - unknown: Unknown status.
    - dead: Failed to start.
- createTime: Filters jobs submitted after the specified time. The format is yyyy-mm-dd HH:mm:ss. When this parameter is specified, timeZone must also be provided.
- timeZone: The time zone of the createTime timestamp, for example, Asia/Shanghai.
- jobId: The ID of the Spark job.
- jobName: The name of the Spark job. Partial matching is supported.
ListSparkJob.responseParamsDescription:
**The job status codes are listed in the following table**
| Status Code | Semantics                                               |
|-------------|---------------------------------------------------------|
| starting    | Starting; the job has not yet executed.                 |
| running     | The job is executing.                                   |
| error       | The program in the job failed and threw an exception.   |
| dead        | The job failed due to resource issues or similar causes.|
| killed      | The job was canceled during execution.                  |
| success     | The job executed successfully.                          |
